paragraphs: Metrix Learning delivers an online learning management system for the public workforce, provided as a custom SkillUpAmerica eLearning portal for each community. The catalog covers 7,000+ courses and 10 career pathways representing 200+ occupations, with training for industry-recognized certifications. The platform also includes integrated job search and integration with Geographic Solutions Virtual One Stop (VOS).

Metrix Learning works directly with state and local governments, non-profits, businesses, and corporations, and each partner relationship is served with a tailored plan. Workforce boards use the platform to support employers in need of talent, with candidate screening tools and skills assessments, customized course clusters, and incumbent worker training. Listed package elements include a custom website with a logo, an annual user license, automated monthly reports, and Mon-Fri 9am-5pm EST customer support.
Metrix Learning is part of Certus, an eLearning certification company, and started as NY Wired for Education with New York-based Workforce Development Boards at its 2008 launch.

quote.text: eLearning portal is designed to strengthen job prospects. Our goal is simple: to promote career pathways that drive economic prosperity.
